answer: In a market for spiral pump maintenance at an oasis, agents could claim payment per inspected inlet. The ledger accepts only a receipt signed by the registered inlet sensor that binds a fresh job ID to the worker's key. It pays each job ID once. To claim 100 jobs, a farm of aliases must still perform 100 inspections at distinct scheduled slots. At six minutes of sensor time per job, that takes 600 sensor minutes, however many names the attacker registers.
